formats.lex: sorted JSON array of packed entry objects

licensing.statement: The packed data is derived and must be redistributed under all applicable source licenses; source and field provenance are retained per entry.

sources.modifications: Original reviewed seed entries are normalized and packed without machine translation.
sources.name: Catalan Dictionary PWA curated expressions

sources.attribution: English Wiktionary contributors; extraction by Kaikki/Wiktextract
sources.modifications: Catalan-language records were normalized, lemma/form records separated, fields deduplicated, and data packed into offline shards.
sources.name: Kaikki Catalan extract of English Wiktionary

sources.modifications: Catalan sections were parsed; wiki markup was reduced to plain definitions and translation/form templates were normalized.
sources.name: Catalan Wiktionary pages-articles dump

sources.modifications: Monolingual paradigms were expanded into a compact surface-to-lemma index; proper-name paradigms were excluded.
sources.name: Apertium Catalan monolingual dictionary

sources.modifications: Spanish-Catalan transfer entries were inverted only where their direction permits and merged as attributed Spanish equivalents.
sources.name: Apertium Spanish-Catalan bilingual dictionary

sources.attribution: FreeDict/WikDict/DBnary/Wiktionary contributors; maintained by Karl Bartel
sources.modifications: TEI headwords, grammar, definitions, translations, and pronunciation were normalized and merged into packed entries.
sources.name: FreeDict Catalan-Spanish dictionary
